pages.text: Press $(k:puffish_skills.open) to open the six skill trees. Each tree has its own experience bar, and every level it gains is 1 point to spend in that tree.$(br2)There is no respec: a node you take stays taken, so plan before you spend.

pages.title: Earning Points
pages.text: Each kill gives Warfare, Marksman, Sorcery and Fortitude the experience the mob drops, all four at once, whatever you killed it with. Every block you break gives Gathering 1, and every craft gives Engineering 1.$(br2)The first level costs 50 experience. The cost climbs to 2,000 by level 27 and stays there; there is no level cap.

pages.title: The Six Trees
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Warfare$(): melee damage, attack speed, health, sword and axe damage$(li)$(bold)Marksman$(): ranged damage, resistance shred, executes, arrow refunds$(li)$(bold)Sorcery$(): magic damage and resistance, mana, healing, pets$(li)$(bold)Fortitude$(): health, damage resistance, healing, toughness$(li)$(bold)Gathering$(): mining speed, extra crops and ore, luck$(li)$(bold)Engineering$(): Haste near stations, crafting bonuses, cheaper repairs

pages.title: Point Budget
pages.text: Every node costs 1 point, the capstones too. A tree has 28 nodes (Warfare has 29), so filling one takes 28 levels, 23,770 experience (25,770 for Warfare).$(br2)A kill feeds all four combat trees, so they fill together. Gathering and Engineering fill only from breaking blocks and crafting.

pages.title: Tree Structure
pages.text: Each tree starts with an 8-node trunk, a single line from its first node. The last trunk node opens two branches of 10 nodes (Warfare's are 11 and 10), each ending in a capstone.$(br2)You can take both branches if you have the points.$(br2)$(bold)Next: press $(k:puffish_skills.open) and pick your class's tree.$()
